# Overrides applied when semgrep.txt is regenerated (uv pip compile --override).
# semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0 exactly (still true of 1.181.0), but mcp < 1.30.0 is affected by
# GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (unbounded session accumulation in the StreamableHTTP transport).
# semgrep imports mcp only for its MCP server, never for `semgrep scan`. semgrep.yaml installs
# the lock with --no-deps, so semgrep's own pin is not re-applied at install time.
# Drop this override once a semgrep release depends on mcp >= 1.30.0.
mcp==1.30.0

# semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry family to ~=1.37.0 / ~=0.58b0, but opentelemetry-api <= 1.45.0 is
# affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (unbounded tracestate parsing). The whole family is moved in
# lockstep (opentelemetry-sdk 1.45.2 requires opentelemetry-api==1.45.2 and
# opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b2). semgrep uses OpenTelemetry only for opt-in tracing.
# opentelemetry-api 1.45.1 is in turn affected by GHSA-mf5v-w3w3-f6cg (quadratic-time traceparent
# parsing, fixed in 1.45.2), so the family is now at 1.45.2 / 0.66b2.
# Drop these overrides once a semgrep release allows opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.2.
opentelemetry-api==1.45.2
opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.2
opentelemetry-proto==1.45.2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.45.2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.2
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b2
opentelemetry-instrumentation==0.66b2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests==0.66b2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading==0.66b2
opentelemetry-util-http==0.66b2
